# Previous tracker project

`yanfei-y12-project.bin` is a 15,728-byte version 1 tracker payload made with
Yanfei v1.6.1-y12 before the section settings were added. Keep this file unchanged.
It has no flash journal header.

The project is named Y12 FIXTURE. Phrase 0 starts with a C major chord at
velocity 100, gate 48, and an OFF on row 1. Chain 0 has phrases 0 through 3.
Song row 1 uses chain 0 on track 1. The song has two rows.

The section and backup tests load this file to check old-format compatibility.
A fixture made by the current encoder would not test that compatibility.
